from flask import Flask, request, render_template_string, g import sqlite3 import os import bleach app = Flask(__name__) DATABASE = '/var/lib/app/comments.db' def get_db(): if 'db' not in g.__dict__: g.db = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE) g.db.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS comments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, username TEXT, body TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)''') return g.db @app.teardown_appcontext def close_db(exception): db = g.__dict__.pop('db', None) if db is not None: db.close() ALLOWED_TAGS = ['b', 'i', 'u', 'em', 'strong', 'a', 'p', 'br'] ALLOWED_ATTRS = {'a': ['href', 'title']} def sanitize_input(text): """Sanitize user input - allows basic formatting tags""" # Note: bleach.clean with strip=False preserves unknown tags as escaped return bleach.clean(text, tags=ALLOWED_TAGS, attributes=ALLOWED_ATTRS, strip=False) @app.route('/comments', methods=['GET']) def list_comments(): db = get_db() cursor = db.execute('SELECT username, body, created_at FROM comments ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50') comments = cursor.fetchall() template = ''' Comments
